note: THE PIN for the skills CLI bundled inside Tortie.app. build/fetch-skills.cjs is the only reader at build time; src/main/skills/resolve.ts reads the sidecar that script writes, never this file. Bump version + integrity + shasum + tree together, never one of them. The hashes come from `npm view skills@<version> dist.integrity dist.shasum`.
compatBandNote: A copy found on the user's PATH is used only when its version sits in [min, belowMajor.0.0). Widening this is a Tier 3 change with an independent verifier, because a CLI version whose output Tortie has never parsed would otherwise drive writes into the user's agent directories.
maxMinorDriftNote: build/check-skills-pin.cjs fails when the published version leaves compatBand, or when it is more than this many minor releases ahead of the pin.
lockVersionsNote: What THIS CLI version writes. Read out of dist/cli.mjs on 2026-08-12: CURRENT_VERSION = 3 at line 3478 for the global lock, CURRENT_VERSION$1 = 1 at line 900 for the project lock. src/main/skills/lock.ts carries the same two numbers and a test asserts the two agree. Both readers DISCARD a lock whose version is below theirs, which is the whole reason the guard exists.
treeNote: Every package the install is allowed to produce, with its exact resolved version. The build fails on a missing package, an extra package or a changed version, so a drifted or compromised transitive cannot enter the bundle unnoticed. Measured 2026-08-12.
